subject: maths
question: A hollow spherical shell is made of a metal of density 40 g/cm³ . Its internal and external radii are 1 cm and 4 cm, respectively. What is the mass (in kg) of the shell? (Take π = (22)/(7))
solution:
**Given:**

Density = 40 g/cm³

Internal radius = 1 cm

External radius = 4 cm

π = 22 ÷ 7

**Formula Used:**

Volume of hollow sphere = (4 ÷ 3) × π × (R³ − r³)

Mass = Density × Volume

**Calculation:**

⇒ R³ = 4³ = 64

⇒ r³ = 1³ = 1

⇒ R³ − r³ = 64 − 1 = 63

⇒ Volume = (4 ÷ 3) × (22 ÷ 7) × 63

⇒ Volume = (4 ÷ 3) × 22 × 9

⇒ Volume = (4 ÷ 3) × 198

⇒ Volume = 4 × 66 = 264 cm³

⇒ Density = 40 g/cm³ = 0.04 kg/cm³

⇒ Mass = 0.04 × 264 = 10.56 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 10.56 kg.**
